description: Use this when the person asks which supplier declarations run out in the coming weeks or which suppliers have not answered, in their own account. Lists supplier × article pairs of the connected account whose supplier declaration on preferential origin ends within the given number of days (default 90), and, unless include_missing is false, every pair without a valid declaration: expired, revoked, requested without answer, refused by the supplier or received and not checked yet. Supplier and article names, end of validity and days left; no addresses. It reads only: requesting again and reminding is done in the dashboard, and the tool returns that link. Do not use to send or schedule a reminder or a new request, or to judge whether goods have preferential origin; that is done in the dashboard.

include_missing.description: Also pairs without a valid declaration, default true

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

name: list_declarations_due
title: Supplier declarations due
